integrity: Exact bit-level boundary computations and a complete finite transvection-orbit certificate; standalone Python 3 program and observed output bundled.
scientific_limitations: The exact magnitude-homology result is for the 80-vertex symplectic generalized quadrangle W(3,3), bidegree (3,5), and coefficients F2 only. The calculation does not establish a q-general formula, integral torsion, or odd-characteristic ranks. Unindexed equivalent calculations cannot be excluded.
title: Exact second-off-diagonal magnitude homology of the symplectic generalized quadrangle of order three
